source.title: The bus does not come (ladder unit, machine-drafted)
source.author: Go course authors (drafted by an AI model)

source.provenance: Drafted by an AI model for the course ladder in contemporary Bokmål (2005 norm); not reviewed by a native speaker. It is controlled, deliberately repetitive Norwegian written for learners and may contain unnatural phrasing. Facts about Norway and Bergen are general knowledge and unchecked. review.notes: Machine-drafted by an AI model; awaiting native-speaker review. House style: moderate Bokmål with three genders (ei/-a for feminine nouns, en/-en masculine, et/-et neuter), weak past in -et, neuter definite plural in -ene, sju and tjue, "ble", "ga". A short problem story in the past tense: waiting, calling, being helped. "Kirka begynte klokka ni" uses the past of "begynne".

english.source: drafted with the text; not reviewed

sentences.text: Det var søndag morgen. Sam skulle til kirka. Kirka begynte klokka ni.
sentences.english: It was Sunday morning. Sam was going to church. Church began at nine.

sentences.text: Det regnet, og det var kaldt. Sam ventet på busstoppet.
sentences.english: It was raining, and it was cold. Sam waited at the bus stop.

sentences.text: Bussen kom ikke. Den var forsinket.
sentences.english: The bus did not come. It was late.

sentences.text: Sam ventet og ventet. Han hadde paraply, men han var nesten våt.
sentences.english: Sam waited and waited. He had an umbrella, but he was almost wet.

sentences.text: Klokka var nesten ni. Bussen var fortsatt ikke her.
sentences.english: It was almost nine o'clock. The bus was still not here.

sentences.text: Sam tenkte: «Jeg kommer sent til kirka.»
sentences.english: Sam thought: "I will be late for church."

sentences.text: Sam tok telefonen og ringte til Lars.
sentences.english: Sam took the phone and called Lars.

sentences.text: Hei, Lars! Bussen er forsinket. Jeg er fortsatt her.
sentences.english: Hi, Lars! The bus is late. I am still here.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Jeg kommer! Jeg tar bilen.
sentences.english: I am coming! I will take the car.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Lars kjørte bilen til Sam. Sam satt i bilen.
sentences.english: Lars drove the car to Sam. Sam sat in the car.

sentences.text: Det regnet fortsatt, men det var varmt.
sentences.english: It was still raining, but it was warm.

sentences.text: Du er våt, Sam! Har du ikke jakke?
sentences.english: You are wet, Sam! Do you not have a jacket?
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Ja, men det regnet mye. Takk, Lars!
sentences.english: Yes, but it rained a lot. Thanks, Lars!
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: De kom klokka ni. Det var nesten sent.
sentences.english: They came at nine o'clock. It was almost late.

sentences.text: Marta satt i kirka. Hun sa: «Hvor var du, Sam?»
sentences.english: Marta was sitting in the church. She said: "Where were you, Sam?"

sentences.text: Bussen var forsinket, men Lars hjalp meg. Han kjørte meg.
sentences.english: The bus was late, but Lars helped me. He drove me.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Du er snill, Lars. Du hjelper alle folk.
sentences.english: You are kind, Lars. You help everyone.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Sam satt i kirka. Han var glad. Han ba: «Gud, takk for Lars.»
sentences.english: Sam sat in the church. He was glad for the help. He prayed: "God, thank you for Lars."

sentences.text: Hils mamma fra oss alle. Vi håper at dere kommer snart.
sentences.english: Say hello to Mum from all of us. We hope that you will come soon.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Om vinteren drar Anna og Lars til hytta. De går på ski, og de sitter i stua med peisen.
sentences.english: In winter Anna and Lars go to the cabin. They ski, and they sit in the living room with the fireplace.

sentences.text: På sytten mai feirer folk Norge. De har flagg og bunad, og de går i tog. De spiser is og pølse.
sentences.english: On the seventeenth of May people celebrate Norway. They have flags and bunads, and they walk in a parade. They eat ice cream and sausage.

sentences.text: Klassen får et spørsmål, og Nils har en prøve.
sentences.english: The class gets a question, and Nils has a test.

sentences.text: Marta levde på en gård med en hest. Livet var bra, og noen ganger kjørte hun.
sentences.english: Marta lived on a farm with a horse. Life was good, and sometimes she drove.

sentences.text: Kjære Anna, takk for brevet. Hilsen Sam
sentences.english: Dear Anna, thank you for the letter. Greetings, Sam

sentences.text: Kjære Lars, takk for hjelpen. Hilsen Sam
sentences.english: Dear Lars, thank you for the help. Greetings, Sam

sentences.text: Sam skriver et brev til dere. Han hilser fra Bergen, og dere får hilsen.
sentences.english: Sam writes a letter to you. He sends greetings from Bergen, and you get a greeting.
